summary: Dedicated preschool teacher with over nine years of continuous classroom experience in early childhood education, specializing in play-based learning and individualized instruction. Proven ability to design engaging activities that support physical, mental, and social development while maintaining a safe, structured environment.

experience.title: Lead Preschool Teacher
experience.employer: a mid-size regional early learning center
bullets: Plan and lead daily activities for a class of 18 students, including games, arts and crafts, music, storytelling, and field trips that promote physical, mental, and social growth
Teach foundational skills such as color, shape, number and letter recognition, personal hygiene, and social skills through hands-on materials and imaginative play
Establish and enforce behavior rules and classroom procedures, reducing incident reports by 30% over two years
Meet with guardians quarterly to discuss student progress, developmental needs, and strategies to promote learning at home
Adapt teaching methods and instructional materials to meet varying needs and interests, including for students with developmental delays

experience.title: Preschool Teacher
bullets: Organized and led developmentally appropriate activities for 15 children aged 3-4, focusing on social-emotional learning and early literacy
Provided a variety of materials and resources for children to explore, manipulate, and use in both learning and imaginative play
Served meals and snacks in accordance with nutritional guidelines and attended to basic needs including feeding, dressing, and diapering
Monitored student progress and maintained written records, using active listening and observation to inform instructional adjustments
Collaborated with co-teachers to design learning strategies that improved kindergarten readiness scores by 25%

experience.title: Assistant Preschool Teacher
bullets: Supported lead teachers in implementing daily lesson plans and classroom routines for up to 20 students
Led small-group activities in reading comprehension, early mathematics, and science exploration through guided play
Assisted with behavior management and maintained a safe, orderly classroom environment
Communicated daily with guardians regarding student activities, meals, and developmental milestones
Prepared classroom materials and ensured cleanliness and organization of learning stations

experience.title: Teacher Aide
bullets: Assisted in supervising children during structured play, meals, and rest periods
Helped prepare and distribute learning materials for arts, crafts, and storytelling activities
Supported personal hygiene routines and basic care needs under teacher supervision
Observed student interactions and reported behavioral or developmental concerns to lead staff

education.degree: Associate of Applied Science in Early Childhood Education
